job.text: What fraction of all donations did Mrs. Smith give?

insight.important: Mrs. Smith contributed almost a quarter of all donations

title.text: Mrs. Smith Contributed Almost a Quarter of All Donations

source.shows: the fraction of the total that one part is: a pie, which shows familiar fractions such as a quarter at a glance (G1.36); every slice its own colour in slice order, largest first from 12 o'clock, the names outside with each value under them, two-line names where they are long (G7.25–G7.28); the slice the insight names in the strong shade of its colour (G8.9)

the book's labels with percentages (s. 0222): the percentages of the total under the names, formatted as one set (whole per cents, the fewest decimals that keep the values apart); a supplement to the slices, not what carries the message (R7-10, G8.20)
a legend instead of labels beside the slices: refused, the reader's eye would shuttle between the keys and the slices (R7-34, G7.27)

overrides.reason: the legend version, rebuilt for comparison

source.shows: the legend drawn through an override: a row of keys above the pie, in slice order, and nothing beside the slices

the same five parts as a treemap: drawn, with the guided finding that parts few enough for a pie belong in one, since a pie shows their fractions better (G1.36, G1.39; R7-15 when the chooser has not already said so)
